en: Black‑and‑white panoramic view of a European town in a river valley, taken from a field with harvested grain sheaves in the foreground. The middle ground shows dense 3–4 story residential blocks with steep gabled roofs and several factory chimneys. Dominating the skyline is a tall clock‑tower with an onion‑shaped Baroque dome attached to a prominent civic or religious building, surrounded by other church spires. Behind the town rise wooded hills and patchwork farmland. There is no visible printed caption or writing on the image side.
